ticket.subject: Wrong name in your records
ticket.body_text:
Hi there!

Please correct my personal data under GDPR: my name changed, and invoices and emails still use the old one.

I already changed it in my profile, but it did not reach the other systems.

There is no deadline here. Thank you.

Thanks so much!
Priya Novak
founder, Hollowfen Media
